name: Cồn Quy
kicker: Longan orchard on the Tiền, beside Cồn Phụng
summary: A longan orchard on the Tiền, with honey tea and a ditch you can bail for fish and cook. It is often the same boat as Cồn Phụng. Skip it if the nine-dragon court is the only stop you wanted. No kilometer was printed, and the fee is check on arrival.
timeNeeded: A stop on the river day
getThere: No kilometer was printed. Do not reuse the Cồn Phụng distances.
heroCaption: A longan garden path on Cồn Quy

notice.title: The blossom month was not printed
notice.body: Check on arrival for the longan blossom. This orchard is not the Đạo Dừa ground on Cồn Phụng.

body: The national rural page names Cồn Quy as a longan orchard, with honey tea and a ditch you can bail for fish and cook. No commune and no kilometer were printed. Do not reuse the 12 km, the 25 km, or the about 10 km that belong to Cồn Phụng. A month for the blossom is check on arrival.

The boat that reaches Cồn Phụng often continues here. A separate fare was not printed. Check on arrival. The visit is the orchard path and a sampan in the creek. The four nicknames are Long, Lân, Quy, and Phụng. Lân has no bank named.

gettingThere: No commune, no kilometer, and no minute were printed for Cồn Quy. Check on arrival. It sits with the other nicknames on this bank of the Tiền, and it is not cù lao Thới Sơn.
